lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured 2D grid of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the pectoral fin base, organized into five vertical columns and four horizontal rows of varying intensity.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal spot lanes, forming a regular rectangular lattice with high-luminance blobs positioned at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges traversing the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with light-saturated upper boundaries and shadowed lower margins.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains approximately eight distinct high-luminance circular blobs distributed across the medial and posterior surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes are visible beneath the ventral midline and posterior to the left pectoral fin.
